name: Shua
overview: The name Shua appears in Scripture referring to two distinct individuals: a Canaanite woman who became the wife of Judah and the mother of his sons, and a daughter of Heber mentioned as a sister to Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham. Genesis 38 highlights Shua as Judah's wife, whose death is noted, while 1 Chronicles 2 connects her as the Canaanitess mother of Judah's sons, including Er, who was judged by the Lord. Additionally, 1 Chronicles 7 identifies Shua as a sister within Heber's family, showing the name's use in different genealogical contexts.
